Learn more about how our products can help your schools run efficiently and affordably.

Learning Management System: Manages Units, Lessons, and Assignments Online

Take your classroom online. Use the TeacherEase Learning Management System and Curriculum Tools. Create, manage, and copy units and lessons from class-to-class and year-to-year. Share curriculum with colleagues. Assign work to students or post resources for them to view online. Integrates seamlessly with your gradebook.

  • Play Webinar
  • PDF Guide

    Use Your Data: Reports in SchoolInsight

    Utilize data to make decisions. Communicate information to staff or parents. Integrate your data with custom forms and letter templates. Track progress through the year and find patterns. Topics include custom reports, custom forms, letter templates, groups, and reports for attendance, tuition & fees, discipline, instructors, standards-based grading, and curriculum.

    • Play Webinar
    • PDF Guide

      Online Registration: Easily Enroll Students for Next Year

      Ready to register students for next year? SchoolInsight's Online Registration module can help. Learn how parents can re-enroll current students, add younger siblings to the district, and register entirely new families too. Save admins time, reduce data entry by staff, and maintain control of the process. Forms can be distributed electronically and fees collected online without handling cash or checks. Admins review all data prior to accepting it into the system.
